caption:
Which breath, when? Four breathing exercises and the moments each was studied in.

Cyclic sighing: when worry spikes. Box breathing: before a hard task, or when worry spikes. Coherence breathing: winding down at night. Belly breathing: as a regular habit.

Not sure where to start? Pick the one that feels easiest. If you feel light-headed or tingly, go back to your usual breathing.

The moving version of this week's carousel. The full carousel and our guided practice Reels are on our profile @equal_psychology.
